title: Gandhian Strategy
definition: The Gandhian Strategy of economic development prioritizes a decentralized, self-reliant village economy (Gram Swaraj) centered on human dignity, cottage industries, trusteeship, and moral growth over material hedonism.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for GS Paper III (Economy - Planning, Inclusive Growth, Decentralization) and GS Paper IV (Ethics - Gandhian Ethics, Integrity, Altruism). Frequently tested in Prelims regarding economic thinkers, Sarvodaya, and decentralized planning.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Gandhian Strategy.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Indian economic history post-independence
Philosophical foundations of the Indian National Movement
